blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate finance subcommittee approved the proposed P2.9-billion 2027 budget of the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) and its attached agencies on Thursday. The endorsement covers the agency’s lump-sum funds, budgetary support for government-owned and controlled corporations, and allocations to local government units. READ: Making sense of the 2027 national budget Budget Secretary Kim Robert De Leon said the DBM’s proposed budget under the National Expenditure Program was reduced from P5.486 billion to P2.9 billion, but he assured senators that no public service would be adversely affected by the cut. “This is the classic example of DBM […]...
